verses.1: The Praise of a Canticle, of David himself. In the time before the Sabbath, when the earth was founded.
verses.2: The Lord has reigned. He has been clothed with beauty.
verses.3: The Lord has been clothed with strength, and he has girded himself. Yet he has also confirmed the world, which will not be moved.
verses.4: My throne is prepared from of old. You are from everlasting.
verses.5: The floods have lifted up, O Lord, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods have lifted up their waves,
verses.6: before the noise of many waters. Wondrous are the surges of the sea; wondrous is the Lord on high.
verses.7: Your testimonies have been made exceedingly trustworthy. Sanctity befits your house, O Lord, with length of days. [ Psalm 93 ] (94)
